visual_review.method: All 14 final pages inspected in four contact sheets; full-size pages 5 and 8 inspected for proof formulas.
visual_review.findings: No clipping, overlapping text, missing formulas, broken tables or illegible diagram found. Headers and page numbering consistent.

runtime.invocation: Windows CMD, conda activate torment, python -B

proof_boundary: Complete written proofs establish limits, domains and inequalities; finite checks are supporting evidence, not simulations or formal verification.
